name: Cadessa Irwin
source:
She is a skilled female mercenary, commonly known as "Cadessa the Storm".

She is nicknamed "Cadessa the Storm" due to the way she slaughters enemies one after another with a large sword that is not suited to her feminine appearance.

She is a beautiful woman with large breasts, a voluptuous body, and a somewhat seductive personality.

However, her hidden muscles are well-trained, and her true personality is tomboyish and bold.


[Translated from [url=https://www.turumiku.jp/product/gouhou/#character02]the official site[/url]]
